title: CNMD - CycleLane schema
description: A cycle lane, aligned with FIWARE Smart Data Models and INSPIRE.

addressLocality.description: The locality, which must correspond to the municipality

addressRegion.description: The NUTS 2 region in which the locality is located

district.description: The administrative district in which the locality is located

type.description: Property. NGSI entity type. It must be CycleLane.

averageSlope.description: Property. Average slope of the cycle lane, normally expressed as a percentage. Units:'P1'. Model:'https://schema.org/Number'.

beginLifespanVersion.description: Property. Beginning of the real-world version. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'.

connectsTo.description: Relationship. Cycle lanes directly connected to this cycle lane.

endLifespanVersion.description: Property. End of the real-world version. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'.

image.description: Property. URLs of images associated with the cycle lane. Model:'https://schema.org/URL'.

lastMaintenance.description: Property. Date of the last maintenance. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'.

length.description: Property. Length of the cycle lane, normally in kilometres. Units:'KMT'. Model:'https://schema.org/Number'.

license.description: Property. License associated with the data. Model:'https://schema.org/URL'.

maintainer.description: Relationship. Party responsible for maintaining the cycle lane.

maxAltitude.description: Property. Maximum altitude reached by the cycle lane. Units:'MTR'. Model:'https://schema.org/Number'.

maxSlope.description: Property. Maximum slope of the cycle lane, normally expressed as a percentage. Units:'P1'. Model:'https://schema.org/Number'.

minAltitude.description: Property. Minimum altitude reached by the cycle lane. Units:'MTR'. Model:'https://schema.org/Number'.

nearBy.description: Relationship. Nearby infrastructure and points of interest relevant to cyclists.

nextMaintenance.description: Property. Date of the next scheduled maintenance. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'.

pavementCondition.description: Property. Observed pavement quality, where 5 is excellent. Model:'https://schema.org/Number'.

pavementType.description: Property. Type of pavement used on the cycle lane.

refNetwork.description: Relationship. Cycle network to which the cycle lane belongs.

segregation.description: Property. Type of separation provided for the cycle lane.

status.description: Property. State of conservation of the cycle lane.

typology.description: Property. Typology of the cycle lane.

updateFrequency.description: Property. Frequency with which the data is updated. Model:'https://schema.org/Text'.

version.description: Property. Version of the data model. Model:'https://schema.org/Text'.
